question: Which local GGUF, if either, is a faithful conversion of the canonical upstream Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct weights?
method: Range-fetched model.safetensors from https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (the source weights repo, not the GGUF repo), parsed its header, extracted three F32 layer-norm tensors, converted BF16->F32, and compared element-by-element against the same tensors read directly out of each local GGUF. Layer-norm tensors are stored as F32 and are never touched by the Q4_0 quantizer, so they must be bit-identical between any two faithful conversions of the same checkpoint.

established: The 352,972,352-byte local file (sha256 c8cd5f37...), which produced every committed Finding 1/2 measurement, is a BIT-EXACT conversion of the canonical upstream Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct weights: 896/896 elements match on all three layer-norm tensors checked, max absolute difference exactly 0.

The 428,730,208-byte file named by scripts/models.txt (sha256 7671c0c3..., the live Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF blob) matches 0 of 2,688 checked elements against the same upstream tensors, diverging by up to 4.24.
Layer-norm tensors are F32 and are not quantized under file_type=2, so this difference cannot be a quantization artifact.
The Apache-2.0 attribution for the historical baseline is therefore sound on the strongest possible basis: the weights are demonstrably the upstream Qwen weights.
not_established: The download URL the 353 MB baseline originally came from. It is identified here by content, not by origin. Content-addressed identity against upstream is stronger evidence than a URL would have been, but the provenance chain itself remains unrecorded.

Why the published Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF q4_0 blob diverges from the upstream weights it is named for. That is an observation about a third-party artifact, not a claim about its cause. Note only that its own metadata self-reports general.size_label as shown above.
Whether the divergence would change any dispatch verdict. It would not have been detectable through this project's measurements either way, since all 10 verdicts reproduced across both files.
